title: Protein Peanut Butter Dip
summary: This protein peanut butter dip is creamy, naturally sweet and made with white beans, banana and raspberries for an easy, filling snack for kids.
ingredients: 1-2 tablespoons water or unsweetened almond milk
steps: Add the white beans, peanut butter, banana, and 1 tablespoon water or unsweetened almond milk to a food processor. Blend until completely smooth and creamy, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed.
If the mixture is too thick, add additional liquid 1 teaspoon at a time and continue blending until it reaches a thick, smooth, spreadable consistency.
Add the raspberries to a small bowl and mash thoroughly with a fork.
Spoon the peanut butter mixture into a serving bowl and gently swirl the mashed raspberries through the top.
